# PupLume

> The ultimate intelligent companion for new dog parents. Track routines, predict potty breaks, manage health records, and receive AI-guided puppy training advice all in one app.

PupLume is a mobile-first digital organizer and AI co-pilot built specifically for the critical first year of a dog's life. It replaces disorganized physical notes and fragmented apps with a unified system for puppy routines, preventive wellness, and early developmental training.

## Core Pages & Resources

- [PupLume Home](https://puplume.pet/): Official landing page, overview of core capabilities, and application preview.
- [App Features](https://puplume.pet/features): Detailed walkthrough of smart routine logging, AI co-pilot insights, and multi-user family sync.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://puplume.pet/pricing): Simple, transparent one-time purchase ($24.99 USD) providing lifetime access without recurring subscriptions.
- [Puppy Training Academy](https://puplume.pet/academy): Age-tailored curriculum covering crate training, biting inhibition, potty schedules, and basic obedience.
- [Pet Health Center](https://puplume.pet/health): Digital health records, automated vaccination booster reminders, growth tracking, and vet notes.
- [Privacy Policy](https://puplume.pet/legal/privacy): Privacy policy and data protection standards for user and pet information.
- [Terms of Service](https://puplume.pet/legal/terms): Service terms and license conditions for PupLume web and mobile applications.

## Key Capabilities

1. **Predictive Routine & Potty Logging**: Log potty breaks, meals, sleep cycles, and outdoor walks in a single tap. The system analyzes chronological intervals to predict when the puppy needs to go out next.
2. **AI Co-Pilot (Intelligent Assistant)**: Context-aware advice personalized to the puppy's breed, age in weeks, weight, and logged behavior patterns.
3. **Preventive Health Center**: Cloud vault for vaccination certificates, medication schedules, weight velocity charts, and vet contact details.
4. **Structured Training Curriculum**: Step-by-step guides developed for critical socialization and behavioral milestones.
5. **Real-time Family Sync**: Household synchronization so partners, family members, or dog sitters have synchronized real-time schedules.
